metadata.title: Warehouse Audit Working Pack
metadata.intendedUse: Plan a scoped warehouse review, record evidence and carry findings through to action and verification.
metadata.scopeLimit: The 28 starter checks need the requirements, goods, activities and operating conditions of your review. They do not provide a complete legal or sector-specific audit, certification or an overall pass score.
metadata.examplesNote: Examples are fictional and separate from blank working records.

instructions.title: Start with the decision
instructions.text: Record the question this review must answer, the areas to examine and who will use the findings. You can plan evidence before making observations.

instructions.title: Establish the criteria
instructions.text: Name the applicable procedure, agreement or other requirement and its version. Assign it to the relevant check. Write 'Not yet established' where it is unknown.

instructions.title: Keep the sample visible
instructions.text: Record the goods, locations, shifts, period and transactions examined. Keep exclusions and evidence limits with the conclusion.

instructions.title: Use evidence references
instructions.text: Enter short observations and record references. Use roles and site aliases where sufficient; avoid copying customer details or sensitive records into the pack.

instructions.title: Leave uncertainty open
instructions.text: A blank status means Not reviewed. Record missing criteria, conflicting accounts and unanswered questions. Label a possible cause as a hypothesis.

instructions.title: Assign the next step
instructions.text: Give each concern an action owner, target date and verification plan. Keep the person doing the work separate from anyone who must approve resources or make a decision.

instructions.title: Separate completion from effectiveness
instructions.text: Record what was completed, then what the follow-up check showed. Work completed without effectiveness evidence remains awaiting verification.

instructions.title: Adapt the working record
instructions.text: Save a copy before entering your review. Keep the starter check IDs and add local checks where needed. The examples illustrate recording; they are not findings about your operation.

statuses.meaning: No assessment recorded. Plan the evidence still needed.
Your evidence supports the check within the stated scope. Name the criterion and supporting reference; missing support remains a gap.
Record the observation, requirement and evidence, then assign follow-up. Do not assume the cause is established.
The available information does not settle the question. Preserve the uncertainty and request the next evidence.
Explain why the check falls outside this review. A missing reason remains an unresolved scope gap.

examples.title: Repeated inventory discrepancy
examples.label: Fictional worked example — investigation remains open
examples.purpose: Show how a confirmed difference can be recorded without inventing its cause or treating a balance adjustment as closure.

scope.decision: What explains the recurring difference, and what action should follow?
scope.period: Comparison time and review dates not yet recorded.
scope.operatingConditions: Movement timing and unit history remain to be reconciled.
scope.sample: SKU-104 in bin A-01; count, recount and selected receipt/issue records. Linked checks INV01, INV02 and INV03.
scope.exclusions: This one-item example does not establish the condition of the whole inventory.
scope.criteria: Site inventory procedure identified; version, comparison boundary and applicable steps not yet recorded.
scope.reviewer: Reviewer and any required independent verification not yet assigned.
scope.actionOwner: Inventory lead, working with the process/system owner.
scope.decisionOwner: Adjustment or resource authority to be established under the site's procedure.

findings.criterion: Site inventory procedure. Version and effective comparison criteria not yet recorded.
findings.observation: The physical count for SKU-104 in bin A-01 is 11 units; the inventory record shows 12. A recount confirms 11.
findings.evidenceObtained: Count note, recount, stock-record comparison and references to selected receipt/issue records in this fictional case.
findings.evidenceNeeded: Reconcile receipt/issue timing, the record snapshot and unit/pack definitions at the comparison point.
findings.uncertainty: The difference is confirmed. Its cause, full transaction boundary and required action remain unresolved.
findings.possibleCause: Hypothesis only: unit-of-measure or transaction-timing issue. Neither is established.
findings.nextAction: Compare the receipt/issue trail and unit definitions with the process/system owner. Retain the explanation supported by evidence. Handle any balance adjustment separately under the authorised process.
findings.verificationMethod: After an evidenced action is chosen, examine subsequent relevant transactions and counts against the agreed criterion. Define the sample and timing before verification.
findings.decisionNeeded: Establish adjustment authority and any process/system decision once the evidence is reviewed.

examples.managementNote: Keep the one-unit difference, uncertain explanation and missing verification assignment visible. The case does not establish a missed pick, loss or successful fix.

examples.title: Warehouse-provider renewal
examples.label: Fictional worked example — renewal decision remains open
examples.purpose: Bring service, storage and billing evidence to one decision while retaining separate criteria, owners and unanswered questions.

scope.decision: Renew the provider contract, request changes or seek further evidence?
scope.period: Renewal review period, shipment sample and billed period not yet agreed.
scope.operatingConditions: Workload, staffing and exception context to be obtained for selected shipments.
scope.sample: Selected late dispatches, goods affected by the storage concern and disputed invoice lines. Linked checks FLOW03, FLOW04, GOODS02, GOODS04, CONTROL03 and CONTROL04.
scope.exclusions: This review has not established all provider qualifications or every product, legal or commercial requirement.
scope.criteria: Dispatch commitment, goods/customer storage requirement and applicable contract/rate version remain to be obtained and assigned to the relevant issue.
scope.reviewer: Service, product/quality and commercial/finance owners provide evidence. Review responsibilities and any specialist assessment to be agreed.
scope.actionOwner: A separate responsible owner for each issue.
scope.decisionOwner: Logistics director for renewal; other approval authorities to be established where required.

findings.criterion: Agreed dispatch commitment and relevant agreement version not yet attached.
findings.observation: Recent dispatches are reported late. The selected shipment records have not yet been compared with the agreed commitment.
findings.evidenceObtained: Reported service concern in this fictional case; supporting timestamps not yet attached.
findings.evidenceNeeded: Agreed commitment, order-release and actual dispatch timestamps, workload, staffing and exception records for the selected shipments.
findings.uncertainty: Extent, contractual significance and reason for the delays remain unconfirmed.
findings.nextAction: Obtain and compare the selected shipment records with the commitment; identify the constraint supported by the evidence.
findings.verificationMethod: Once an action and service criterion are agreed, compare later relevant shipment performance and exception records. Verification period not yet established.
findings.decisionNeeded: Consider any evidenced resource or service condition as part of renewal.

findings.criterion: Actual product/customer storage requirement and its applicable version not yet established.
findings.observation: A customer has raised a storage concern. The affected goods, location and acceptability have not yet been established.
findings.evidenceObtained: Reported customer concern in this fictional case; supporting condition records not yet attached.
findings.evidenceNeeded: Affected goods/location, applicable storage requirement, monitoring records, reported exception and competent assessment of acceptability.
findings.uncertainty: The concern does not establish product condition, a breached requirement or the required disposition.
findings.nextAction: Establish the applicable requirement, assess the affected goods and determine any action and verification needed.
findings.verificationMethod: Define the evidence needed to verify the chosen action against the actual storage requirement; method remains to be agreed by the responsible assessor.
findings.verificationResult: Pending — no acceptability or effectiveness conclusion
findings.decisionNeeded: Bring the assessment, required action and remaining uncertainty into the renewal review.
findings.decisionOwner: Logistics director; product disposition authority not yet established

findings.criterion: Applicable contract/rate version, charging basis and billed period not yet attached.
findings.observation: Some invoice charges are disputed. The relevant invoice lines have not yet been reconciled to the agreement and activity records.
findings.evidenceObtained: Reported billing dispute in this fictional case; selected invoice and activity references not yet attached.
findings.evidenceNeeded: Contract/rate version, invoice lines, charging units, movement/storage/service records for the billed period and documented exceptions.
findings.uncertainty: Interpretation, entitlement and any adjustment remain unresolved. No saving has been established.
findings.nextAction: Reconcile the selected invoice lines and charging units with the agreement and activity evidence; record any interpretation needing a decision.
findings.verificationMethod: Check any agreed resolution against the reconciled activity and resulting invoice or credit record. Requirements and reviewer remain to be agreed.
findings.verificationResult: Pending — no entitlement or resolution conclusion
findings.decisionNeeded: Resolve any outstanding commercial interpretation and present it alongside the service and storage evidence.
findings.decisionOwner: Commercial/finance authority to be established; logistics director for renewal

examples.managementNote: The director's renewal decision remains open. A service finding does not settle storage acceptability, provider qualification or invoice entitlement.

managementPrompts.label: Decision to make
managementPrompts.prompt: What decision is requested, and who has authority to make it?

managementPrompts.label: Scope and limits
managementPrompts.prompt: Which site, period, goods and sample support this brief? What was excluded?

managementPrompts.label: Findings and consequences
managementPrompts.prompt: What does the evidence establish, against which requirement, and what decision or activity does it affect?

managementPrompts.label: Open evidence and criteria
managementPrompts.prompt: What remains missing, uncertain or conflicting? What evidence could change the decision?

managementPrompts.label: User-flagged urgent concerns
managementPrompts.prompt: Record any concern the reviewer has flagged as urgent and its responsible response owner. Do not average it into an overall score.

managementPrompts.label: Options and resources
managementPrompts.prompt: What options are supported, what resources or approvals are needed, and what remains undecided?

managementPrompts.label: Decision and commitments
managementPrompts.prompt: Record the decision, rationale, action owners, target dates and any unresolved dependency.

managementPrompts.label: Follow-through
managementPrompts.prompt: Who checks effectiveness, using what evidence and when? What happens if the concern remains or returns?

findingPrompts.label: Finding and linked check
findingPrompts.prompt: Give the finding an ID and record the starter check ID or custom area.

findingPrompts.label: Criterion or reference
findingPrompts.prompt: What requirement applies? Record the relevant version or Not yet established.

findingPrompts.label: Observation and evidence
findingPrompts.prompt: What was observed, when and where? Add the record reference and sample.

findingPrompts.label: Evidence limits and possible cause
findingPrompts.prompt: What is uncertain? Keep a possible cause labelled as a hypothesis until evidence supports it.

findingPrompts.label: Consequence or decision affected
findingPrompts.prompt: Why does this finding matter within the stated review?

findingPrompts.label: Next action
findingPrompts.prompt: Specify correction, investigation, corrective action or verification; describe the next step.

findingPrompts.label: Owner and target date
findingPrompts.prompt: Who will do the work, by when? Leave an unassigned owner or unagreed date visible.

findingPrompts.label: Urgency assigned by reviewer
findingPrompts.prompt: Choose Not assessed, Routine follow-up or User-flagged urgent concern. Use the site's response process for an immediate concern.

findingPrompts.label: Decision or resources needed
findingPrompts.prompt: What prevents progress, who can resolve it and what decision is requested?

findingPrompts.label: Completion record
findingPrompts.prompt: What was completed, on what date and with which evidence?

findingPrompts.label: Effectiveness verification
findingPrompts.prompt: Record the method, reviewer, date, result and remaining limitations. Completion alone does not verify effectiveness.
